info.description: VATmiraal determines the VAT treatment of a transaction: the tax grid it maps to, the legal justifications behind it, and any warnings or inconsistencies. Supporting endpoints expose the vocabulary needed to describe a transaction and infer objects from natural-language descriptions.
info.title: VATmiraal API

get.description: Returns whether the service is up. Use this as a liveness probe; it requires no authentication.
Lists every object category, with its label, broad category, the transaction types it applies to, and the properties it accepts.
Lists the broad categories that object categories are grouped under, each with its value and label.
Returns a single broad object category by its value, together with every object category that belongs to it.
get.summary: Get a broad object category by value

get.description: Returns a single object category by its value, with its label, broad category, applicable transaction types, and accepted properties.
get.summary: Get an object category by value

post.description: Derives a structured object from a free-text description, returning its type, the inferred transaction type, and any properties recognised. Intended to pre-fill the object of a transaction before analysis.
post.summary: Infer the object from a description

post.description: Analyses a single transaction and returns the tax grid it maps to. For each grid it gives the amount and the legal justifications behind it, along with any warnings and inconsistencies detected. The analysis is run from the chosen perspective (supplier or receiver), which decides whose declaration the tax grid is built for.
post.summary: Analyse a transaction and return its associated tax grid
